data_policy.confirmation: same corpus split=calibration, selected candidate only after dev freeze
data_policy.blind_final: v13 protocol, generate only after full candidate freeze

selection_rule.primary: maximize harmonic mean of supported-operation routed accuracy and near-domain unsupported-operation rejection among candidates meeting both floors
selection_rule.no_promotion: If no candidate meets both floors and improves the prior MiniLM harmonic mean, retain the existing MiniLM profile.

hygiene: Do not inspect v12 or generate v13 during development selection.
Do not inspect calibration results for non-selected beta values.
Freeze beta and all upstream routing parameters before the calibration confirmation run.
Calibration may veto promotion but must not be used to choose a different beta.
Generate and score v13 only after the complete candidate configuration is frozen.
